# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Native hardening and Uno compatibility**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.3 backports native safety fixes and corrects WebAssembly linking for Uno 6 applications. The servicing update keeps the managed API unchanged while bringing additional Skia fixes to the line available to Uno Platform 6 apps.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Security

- **Skia safety backports** — Backports 25 additional CVE fixes and 13 hardening and test fixes to m155, covering shader execution, GPU resource and upload handling, texture sampling, glyph bounds and allocation arithmetic. These complement the earlier 4.155 backports without changing public APIs or bindings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5844](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5844))

## Bug Fixes

- **Uno 6 WebAssembly linking on newer .NET** — Stops passing -sUSE_WEBGPU for Uno WebAssembly builds on .NET 9 and later, avoiding a conflict with Dawn's WebGPU port. .NET 8 retains the flag required by its built-in port. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
